title: Supply Chain Attack on github.com/boltdb-go/bolt
technical_mechanism: Go Module Proxy cached backdoored version; RCE and C2 beacon; persisted 3+ years
summary: A malicious package 'github.com/boltdb-go/bolt' was discovered in the Go ecosystem. The attack involved typosquat + proxy-cache persistence + RCE backdoor. Mechanism: Go Module Proxy cached backdoored version; RCE and C2 beacon; persisted 3+ years
